RL01.P1.statement:
Native releases SHALL pin source, SDK, device profiles, dependencies and build
settings. The manifest SHALL declare watchface type, a stable application UUID,
only qualified products/languages and the minimum required API. FR165 baseline
SHALL fit its checked API 5.2 support without API 6-only dependencies. SDK version
SHALL NOT be treated as device runtime support.

WF11.P1.oracle: Actual current Fitness real-SDK/ordinary six-role observations plus four compiled exact-body API-boundary tests: literal distinct source values, one newest sample traces, thrown denied/unavailable calls, missing modules/functions/fields/samples. Actual view/formatter missing replacement and time/cache continuity reused. No Python health reimplementation.
WF11.P1.planning_status: Whole software property implemented; complete clean graph execution and self verification, followed by one different peer and root judgment. No physical or Store acceptance.
scenarios: A selected history metric is unavailable
WF11.P1.statement:
Fields SHALL use available Garmin APIs and only necessary declared permissions.
Steps/calories, watch charge and recent heart-rate/Body Battery/stress samples
SHALL retain distinct sources. Feature checks SHALL handle unsupported APIs,
denied permissions and absent samples. Reading a field SHALL NOT enable raw
sensor streaming, parse entire histories or upload personal data.
